month_notes: Hanoi’s best weather month, and the airport feels it. China’s National Day week fills the first seven days from Shanghai, Guangzhou and Shenzhen, Europe and North America are in full autumn season, and from the 25th the winter schedule takes over — so the second half of the month is a different timetable from the first.
empty_band_note: Quieter, but Noi Bai never fully empties — twelve flights still land overnight

context.text: Terminal 2 reopened in expanded form on 19 December 2025 at 200,164 m², lifting capacity from 10 to 15 million passengers a year. Immigration handles roughly 44,000–45,000 arrivals and departures a day, and since 3 August 2026 foreign passport holders have had their own lane.
context.source: Bao Chinh phu and Tuoi Tre, August 2026; Noi Bai T2 expansion, December 2025

basis: based on flight schedules and official airport data from 2025–2026
